description: StorageConnectorSource is polymorphic (discriminator type: DataShare -> DataShareSource) and the converter kept only the base `type` member, so a connector could not send its connection or auth details. Flatten DataShareSource onto the base: `connection` ({ type, dataShareUri }) and `authProperties` ({ type, identityResourceId }). Also add `authProperties` to StorageConnectorSourceUpdate (DataShareSourceUpdate) so a PATCH can rotate the managed identity.
